$comment: LAYER 1 of 3: structural validation only (presence, types, formats, enums). LAYER 2 (semantic certificate validation: rule-specific premise types, scope, coverage, assumptions, quantifiers, graph integrity) and LAYER 3 (independent kernel checking: identity recomputation, rule applicability, premise admissibility) are NOT established by this schema. A schema-valid certificate is not a valid proof. Producer-supplied 'validation' and 'proof_classification' fields are untrusted assertions, never acceptance evidence.

digest.description: Full-length SHA-256 content digest. Truncated digests are rejected; test fixtures must use 64 hex characters.

description: TEST-ONLY normative certificate schema cert/v1 per ADR-KERNEL-001/002 and contracts C1. No production code is wired to this file yet.

assumptions.description: Explicit assumptions. Conclusions exceeding these are rejected at Layer 2.

canonical_proposition.description: Constrained proposition header. Full canonical body lives in the evaluation context; Layer 3 recomputes PropositionID from it.

coverage.description: Null unless the rule requires a coverage premise. Absence/universal claims MUST carry coverage; Layer 2 rejects coverage-free absence proofs (K3) and incomplete coverage presented as complete (G).

implementation_digest.description: Must equal the registered digest for (rule_id, rule_version). Mismatch is release-control failure K9.

inference_instance.description: Typed rule bindings. Required bindings per rule are enforced at Layer 2, not here.

premise_type.description: Producer-declared type; Layer 2 semantic validation re-establishes the true type (K1).

scope.description: Premise scope. Compatibility with the conclusion scope is a Layer 2 check (K11).

proof_classification.description: Producer assertion only. The registry supplies the authoritative label; the checker recomputes it. Never trusted.

rule_id.description: Must name a rule in the closed registry at rule_version. Unknown rules rejected (registry check).

scope.description: Conclusion scope. Completeness and compatibility enforced at Layer 2.

validation.description: Producer-supplied and IGNORED by the checker. The checker's own decision is the only acceptance evidence.

title: cert/v1
